primary.name: black
primary.usage: main colour: backgrounds and the black base of gradient overlays

accent.name: green
accent.usage: accent: one accent per piece, matched to the photo; green, blue, orange and purple are all accents

neutral_dark.name: dark grey
neutral_dark.usage: main colour: the logo's colour on white; dark panels

neutral_mid.name: grey
neutral_mid.usage: main colour: secondary text and lines

neutral_light.name: white
neutral_light.usage: main colour: the logo and text on photos and dark backgrounds

palette.accent_rule: Additional accent colours to be used with discretion, within the same style as the four above (branding document).

tokens_source: ss_green, ss_blue, ss_orange, ss_purple, ss_black, ss_dark_grey, ss_grey and white are the branding document's values (2026-10-14; the four accents had been measured from Content Bank posts within one shade of them). The other tokens (ss_charcoal #3A3A3A, ss_near_black, ss_panel_black, ss_orange_hot, ss_lime, ss_fit_*, *_bright) were measured from real posts on 2026-09-27 and are not in the document; they stay so measured templates keep matching their references.
source: Swing Shack branding document (designer), brand-guide/swingshack-branding-document.pdf, page 4 'Colours'. Replaces the 2026-07-28 'visual best-guess' (deep teal #0F766E, amber #F59E0B), which the document does not contain.
